title: THES Veteran Day Celebration
description: Thunder Hill Elementary School will celebrate and honor our veteran and military families on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Families are invited to help us recognize veterans and military family…
description_full: Thunder Hill Elementary School will celebrate and honor our veteran and military families on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Families are invited to help us recognize veterans and military family members through our Veterans Day slideshow and classroom visits. If you would like a family member included, please complete the Veterans/Military Submission Form by October 25. Please note: If you submitted your veteran’s information last year, you do not need to submit it again. Questions? Contact meagan_lesinski@hcpss.org

description: 🌯 Chipotle Restaurant Night Out – Support Thunder Hill Elementary PTA! Take a break from cooking and support our school! Join us for a delicious Chipotle meal while helping raise funds for Thunder…
description_full: 🌯 Chipotle Restaurant Night Out – Support Thunder Hill Elementary PTA! Take a break from cooking and support our school! Join us for a delicious Chipotle meal while helping raise funds for Thunder Hill Elementary PTA programs and activities. How to Participate: 1. Order through the Chipotle app or Chipotle.com. 2. Select Pickup at the participating Chipotle location. 3. Add your favorite meals to your order. 4. At checkout, enter the fundraiser code in the “Enter a Promo Code” field and click Apply. 5. Complete your purchase and pick up your order during the scheduled fundraiser hours. Important: Online orders must be placed through Chipotle’s app or website. Delivery orders and third-party apps do not qualify. Your cart will show “Fundraiser -$0.01” when the code is successfully applied. ❤️ Every qualifying order helps support our students, teachers, and school community! Thank you for supporting THES PTA!
